findings.title: Second broad equivocation pass can exclude a valid same-sequence change
findings.closure: The authoritative epoch result is propagated directly; no wider post-epoch equivocation pass exists; invalid same-sequence candidates cannot poison valid or accepted-base history; signed Rust and independent TypeScript fixtures pass.

findings.title: Interrupted reports discard accepted control dispositions and accepted-at-control state
findings.closure: Every interruption path preserves all conclusive protocol outcomes; canonical controls and dispositions cannot contradict; exact-boundary tests pass.

findings.title: Selected manifest does not dynamically validate its referenced control
findings.closure: NIP-01 replacement remains first; the selected manifest is resolved against stateful control outcomes; missing, wrong-coordinate, invalid, noncanonical-valid, and canonical-valid references have signed fixtures.

findings.title: Manifest and checkpoint event dispositions reflect static carrier status instead of dynamic protocol validity
findings.closure: Dynamic manifest, descriptor, and chunk outcomes produce canonical event dispositions without contradictions; namespaced digest fixtures and independent TypeScript reports agree.

findings.title: Control preparation and post-stop report construction remain incompletely metered and cancellable
findings.closure: All untrusted-evidence traversals are budgeted and cancellable; ancestry is not repeatedly rescanned; post-stop work is compact and bounded; adversarial tests pass.

findings.title: Requirement matrix and current interoperability evidence are not fully reconciled
findings.closure: All applicable rows are final rather than held; each cross-language row binds the final independent attestation overlay; stale six-fixture evidence is superseded or removed; validators fail closed.

findings.title: The causal Automerge operation-counter formula requires unambiguous implementation authority
findings.closure: Implementation-owned authority states the exact dependency-closure causal-max formula, distinguishes actor sequence from operation counters, and Rust and TypeScript neutral vectors agree. The externally authored NIP snapshot remains unchanged.

findings.title: Sustained native fuzzing and independent external review remain incomplete
findings.closure: The holds remain explicit until authorized execution and review occur; code completion is never represented as publication readiness.
